title: Harmonic basis vector fields on surfaces
summary: In this paper, we study local parameterizations of surfaces in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^3$ whose coordinate vector fields are harmonic sections with respect to the induced Riemannian metric. After introducing the notion of harmonic basis vector fields on a surface, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions under which the coordinate vector fields $\frac{\partial}{\partial u}$ and $\frac{\partial}{\partial v}$ are harmonic.
